ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; visible ventral surface composed of approximately 65% high-intensity (white) and 35% low-intensity (black) pixel regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral symmetry around a central black chevron-shaped region at the notch. Left lobe contains dense vertical black mottling. Right lobe is primarily white with discrete black pixel clusters on the distal tip and trailing margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an internal angle of approximately 82 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Jagged trailing edge with persistent low-amplitude serrations across the full span of both lobes, more pronounced distally.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-outward sweep; the trailing edge maintains a generally linear to slightly concave profile toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark circular pixel groups visible on the outer portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small-scale notches and irregularities along the trailing edge boundary; a single distinct dark focal lesion on the right distal lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast alphanumeric text overlay in the bottom third of the image frame.
